api_endpoint.description: The Crusoe API endpoint. Defaults to `https://api.cloud.crusoe.ai/v1`. Can also be set via `CRUSOE_API_ENDPOINT` environment variable.

profile.description: The name of the profile to use from `~/.crusoe/config`. When specified, credentials and default_project are loaded from this profile. Takes precedence over `CRUSOE_PROFILE` environment variable.

project.description: The default project for resources. Can be a project name or UUID (resolved to UUID internally). Can be overridden per-resource via `project_id`. Takes precedence over `CRUSOE_DEFAULT_PROJECT` environment variable.

block.description: The Crusoe Cloud provider enables management of Crusoe Cloud resources.

nvlink_domain_id.description: NVLink domain ID to use for NVLink communication.

apiserver_extra_args.description: Extra arguments to pass to the kube-apiserver as key-value pairs. Changes take effect after a cluster rotation. To clear args, use the Crusoe CLI.

controller_manager_extra_args.description: Extra arguments to pass to the kube-controller-manager as key-value pairs. Changes take effect after a cluster rotation. To clear args, use the Crusoe CLI.

oidc_ca_cert.description: CA certificate used to verify the OIDC server (optional).

scheduler_extra_args.description: Extra arguments to pass to the kube-scheduler as key-value pairs. Changes take effect after a cluster rotation. To clear args, use the Crusoe CLI.

batch_percentage.description: This feature is currently in development. Reach out to support@crusoecloud.com with any questions. Percentage of nodes to update concurrently during rollout. The calculated number will not exceed 10 nodes. Mutually exclusive with batch_size. If both this and batch_size are omitted, existing nodes will not be updated, but new nodes will use the new configuration.

batch_size.description: This feature is currently in development. Reach out to support@crusoecloud.com with any questions. Number of nodes to update at a time during rollout (minimum 1, maximum 10). Mutually exclusive with batch_percentage. If both this and batch_percentage are omitted, existing nodes will not be updated, but new nodes will use the new configuration.

key.description: Taint key. Follows the Kubernetes qualified-name format (optional DNS subdomain prefix, name segment up to 63 chars). Must be non-empty.

value.description: Taint value. Defaults to empty string if omitted. Must be at most 63 characters.

s3_url.description: S3 endpoint URL for accessing the bucket.

tags.description: Tags applied to the bucket as key-value pairs.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the bucket was last updated (RFC3339 format).

versioning_enabled.description: Enable versioning for the bucket. Once enabled, cannot be disabled.
